d: The Democratic Republic of Congo has sentenced 66 soldiers to death after a military trial in the country's conflict-hit east. The troops were accused of cowardice, mutiny and abandoning their positions during clashes with rebel forces. The verdict comes as the Congolese army struggles to contain rebel advances, while the country battles its deadliest Ebola outbreak. Why is the military taking such a hard line against its own troops? Palki Sharma tells you.
